mapper.sql: SELECT partner_id, company_id, partner_code, partner_name, partner_type, source_module, source_id, tax_number, invoice_title, invoice_address, invoice_phone, payment_days, settlement_type, currency, credit_limit, credit_used, dept_id, user_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_partner
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher_entry WHERE aux_customer_id = #{partnerId} AND del_flag = '0') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher_entry WHERE aux_supplier_id = #{partnerId} AND del_flag = '0')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_partner ( partner_code, partner_name, partner_type, source_module, source_id, tax_number, invoice_title, invoice_address, invoice_phone, payment_days, settlement_type, currency, credit_limit, credit_used, dept_id, user_id, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{partnerCode}, #{partnerName}, #{partnerType}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceId}, #{taxNumber}, #{invoiceTitle}, #{invoiceAddress}, #{invoicePhone}, #{paymentDays}, #{settlementType}, #{currency}, #{creditLimit}, #{creditUsed}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
